## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] It fits the scope in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Tests cover it (`./build.sh test` passes), and a page of the Manual (`Docs/`) describes it.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) and follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Warnings are errors: the build is clean, and there is no runtime reflection or dynamic loading of managed code in `Source/`.
- [ ] If an AI assistant wrote part of it: I read, built and tested all of it, and say so here.
